theme: Light mode primary with Dark mode toggle. Focused on high-contrast accessibility and trust.
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) + High Density Grid. Specifically adapted for Rural Fintech to feel empowering and institutional yet accessible.

headings.rules: Use for all H1-H4. Technical, elegant, tracks well with numbers. Must use tracking-tight for H1-H2.

body.rules: MANDATORY for body text to support Indian languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi). Ensure leading-relaxed for readability.

colors.base: Warm sand, stone grey, off-white. No stark white (#FFFFFF) or pure black.
colors.primary: Deep Forest Green (#0A2E20) - conveys authority and growth.
colors.secondary: Sage (#4A6B53) - secondary actions and subtle highlights.
colors.accent: Terracotta (#C85A32) - for alerts, key CTAs, and warnings.
colors.neutral: Warm Sand (#F4F1EA) for backgrounds, Sandstone (#E8DCC8) for borders.
colors.rules: No generic SaaS blue. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Apply Tinted Grey rule: all greys must be slightly warm. Use color strictly for financial/status states (e.g., green/red for profit/loss).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism. Use warm solid backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-border). Avoid soft UI/Neumorphism to prevent visual refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp 1px borders instead of heavy shadows for definition.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on hero sections or report covers to kill digital flatness.

layouts.general: High Density Grid for the Financial Calculator & Scheme Router. Bento Grid for the Feasibility Report (SWOT, Competitors).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 inside containers. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, inputs, tabular data. Center-align only for empty states or specific visual balance in hero.
layouts.navigation: Visible navigation bar on desktop with Logo, 3-5 links, Language Switcher, and User Profile/Save history CTA. Solid background.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Slider. heavily customized to match the earthy theme. Padding must be generous (h-12 or h-14 inputs) for rural touch targets.
components.charts: Use Shadcn charts (recharts). Implement accessible color palettes (color-blind friendly). Apply for EMI Amortization chart and Moratorium timeline.
components.tables: Use for EMI schedule / Quarterly repayment plan. Tabular typography (right-aligned numbers).
components.pdf_download: Use jspdf and html2canvas. Ensure the download button is a highly visible, pill-shaped primary action button.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp edges with 1px subtle border. Minimal to no border-radius (max 8px). Flat colors.

motion.rules: Subtle, purposeful animations. Hover states must explicitly set text color and lighten the background. Entrance animations for list items and table rows.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NEVER use transition: all.
motion.micro-interactions: Active states on the margin capital slider and scheme selection cards.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='calculate-emi-btn').
accessibility.language: UI must dynamically scale to accommodate longer text strings in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, and Marathi.

hero_portrait.description: Young woman with red headscarf, representing rural empowerment

success_story.description: Man in orange and white shirt smiling

market_context.description: Street vendor selling under a tree

store_context.description: An elderly man sits in a small shop

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. Remove generic text-align: center from root CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8, p-12).
Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients; use flat, high-contrast surfaces with solid backgrounds.
Never use placeholder text or external dummy image URLs. Only use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements and inputs.
Ensure UI accommodates varying string lengths for the 6 target languages.
Do not use generic SaaS blue colors or generic Inter font for headings.
